messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>

Subject: Evaluation staging plan & overage/rate clarifications

Hi James / Anna —

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. Per our call I pulled together a short mutual action plan and the current rate card so we can align on close timelines and how burst/overage will behave during the staging window. Attached: Clearsight_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft) and RateCard_v3.pdf. Also attached a SOC2 excerpt you asked for.

Key asks from your side I heard:
- A short evaluation/staging window before committing
- Temporary elevated burst capacity for a narrow test period
- Clarity on how overage rates and discounts apply if you exceed the initial commit during ramp

What I propose for discussion:
- Staging window: 2 weeks starting on sign-off.
- Temporary elevated cap: up to 2x committed baseline for a one-week contiguous period during staging.
- Billing during elevated cap: bursts billed at the published overage rate; we can offer a 15% discount on overage for the staging week if it is explicitly included in the MAP milestones.
- Committed discount windows and ramp ceilings are in the attached RateCard_v3.pdf (see appendix).

Please review the MAP draft and the rate table, and let me know where you'd like changes. If procurement needs a PO template or legal redlines, loop them in and we’ll respond within 48 business hours.

Next steps: can you confirm (1) preferred staging start date, (2) billing contact for PO, and (3) whether the staging elevated-cap week is acceptable as a MAP milestone?

Thanks —
Aisha
Aisha Rahman
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
redwood.ai

Aisha —

Thanks for the write-up and attachments. A few clarifying questions from the Clearsight side:
1) Can you confirm the numeric overage rate you referenced? Our finance team needs a per-token (or per-request) number to model costs.
2) If we hit >2x the committed baseline before we formally increase the commit (i.e., pre-ramp), will those overages be eligible for any retroactive discount once the higher commit is in place?
3) Are there any hard caps that would block traffic when the account exceeds the temporary elevated cap, or will traffic always flow and just be billed?

Procurement — our billing contact is procurement@clearsight.ai. We will need a sample invoice and PO flow.

We are aiming to start the staging week the week of July 7, pending your confirmation.

Regards,
James

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Jun 2025 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Evaluation staging plan & overage/rate clarifications

Aisha — quick internal note / suggested response:

- Numeric overage rate: propose $0.0035 /k token for standard burst (this is our published overage in RateCard_v3 appendix B). For the staging week we can hold to $0.0029 /k token (15% off) if they commit that the week as a MAP milestone.
- Retroactive discounts: legal prefers not to do retroactive rebates once invoices are issued. We can, however, offer a one-time bill credit equivalent to the staging-week discount if they sign the MAP within 10 business days of the staging ending. That keeps invoicing simple and gives them budget predictability.
- Hard caps vs flow: default behavior is traffic flows and is billed; we can configure account caps if requested but that requires provisioning lead time and may throttle traffic which they don't want for staging. Recommend we keep traffic flowing and rely on billing controls.

If Approved: propose Aisha confirms the numbers and offers the 10-day-sign bonus credit (not retroactive) and the 15% off staging overage rate.

-Marcus
Senior Deals, Redwood Inference

[internal note: loop legal only if they push for retroactive rebates]

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
To: James Caldwell <james.caldwell@clearsight.ai>, Procurement <procurement@clearsight.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Jun 2025 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation staging plan & overage/rate clarifications

James / Procurement —

Thanks — answers below and updated proposal in-line:

1) Numeric overage rate: Standard overage = $0.0035 per 1k tokens. For the agreed staging week we will offer $0.002975 per 1k tokens (15% discount) if that week is explicitly listed as a MAP milestone and you sign the MAP within the window. See RateCard_v3.pdf appendix B for the published numbers.

2) Retroactive discounts: We do not do retroactive price changes on already-issued invoices. Instead we will provide a one-time bill credit equal to the staging-week overage discount (calculated against billed overage during that week) if the MAP is signed within 10 business days after staging ends. That credit will appear on the next invoice.

3) Caps vs flow: We recommend keeping traffic flowing (no hard throttle) for the staging week to avoid false negatives in the evaluation. If you prefer enforced caps we can set them but that requires a 48–72 hour provisioning window and may result in throttled calls once the cap is hit.

Operational items:
- Staging target: week of 2025-07-07 (two-week evaluation window starting 2025-07-07, with a single elevated-cap week inside that window as discussed).
- Billing contact: procurement@clearsight.ai (we will send sample invoice/PO flow to that address).
- Next step: I’ve attached a MAP with the staging week included. If you can confirm acceptance of the staging terms I’ll route the MAP to Legal to finalize and trigger the one-time credit clause.

If that works I’ll also note the commitment ramp milestones and discount bands in the MAP so finance can model.

Thanks —
Aisha
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Clearsight_MAP_v1.xlsx (updated), RateCard_v3.pdf

Procurement will drop a PO once we have the MAP and a sample invoice. Thanks for moving this quickly — we should be able to sign within the 10 business day window if the sample invoice matches the numbers.

Best,
James
